headline: Ra Deck: The Cards You Need
title: The Winged Dragon of Ra Deck | Best Support Cards | Yu-Gi-Oh Master Duel and TCG
video_script: Here is how to build a Winged Dragon of Ra deck. Ra was Marik's Egyptian God in Battle City, and it has the most support cards of the three. When Ra is Normal Summoned, you can pay Life Points until you have one hundred left, and it gains that much attack and defense. Pay one thousand to destroy a monster on the field. Sphere Mode can be summoned with three Tributes from your opponent's side too, and it comes back to you later. Tribute the Sphere to summon Ra from your hand or Deck with four thousand attack. Immortal Phoenix waits in the Graveyard. When Ra goes from the field to your Graveyard, the Phoenix summons itself. It is unaffected by other cards' effects, and for one thousand Life Points it sends a monster to the Graveyard. Millennium Revelation sends a Divine-Beast from your hand to fetch Monster Reborn, and lets Monster Reborn revive Ra from the Graveyard, ignoring its summoning conditions. Ancient Chant adds Ra from your Deck or Graveyard and gives you an extra Tribute Summon that turn. From the Graveyard, it makes Ra's attack the total of the monsters you Tributed. To find your pieces, The True Sun God adds Ra or a card that mentions it, and Guardian Slime adds a Ra Spell or Trap when it goes to the Graveyard. And Blaze Cannon makes Ra unaffected by your opponent's effects, and after Ra attacks, it can send all their monsters to the Graveyard. Which card would you add to this deck? Comment below!
